set -eu
install -d -m 700 /etc/pki/autohttps
cat > /etc/sysconfig/autohttps <<'EOF'
HTTPS_CN=node1
HTTPS_IP=10.100.23.10
CERT_DAYS=7
RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS=259200
EOF
chmod 600 /etc/sysconfig/autohttps
cat > /usr/local/sbin/autohttps-renew <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. /etc/sysconfig/autohttps
cert=/etc/pki/autohttps/active.pem
if [ -s "$cert" ] && openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
fi
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /etc/pki/autohttps/.renew.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes \
    -days "$CERT_DAYS" \
    -subj "/CN=$HTTPS_CN" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$HTTPS_CN,IP:$HTTPS_IP" \
    -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE" \
    -addext "keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment" \
    -addext "extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth" \
    -keyout "$tmpdir/key.pem" -out "$tmpdir/cert.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1
cat "$tmpdir/key.pem" "$tmpdir/cert.pem" > "$tmpdir/active.pem"
chmod 600 "$tmpdir/active.pem"
mv -f "$tmpdir/active.pem" "$cert"
logger -t autohttps-renew "installed renewed HTTPS certificate"
EOF
chmod 700 /usr/local/sbin/autohttps-renew

cat > /usr/local/sbin/autohttps-server.py <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import http.server
import socketserver
import ssl

CERT = "/etc/pki/autohttps/active.pem"
ADDRESS = ("0.0.0.0", 8443)
BODY = b"autohttps is healthy\n"

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(BODY)))
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(BODY)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

class ReloadingTLSServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True
    def get_request(self):
        sock, address = super().get_request()
        context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        context.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
        context.load_cert_chain(CERT)
        try:
            return context.wrap_socket(sock, server_side=True), address
        except Exception:
            sock.close()
            raise

ReloadingTLSServer(ADDRESS, Handler).serve_forever()
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/autohttps-server.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/autohttps.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=HTTPS service with per-connection certificate reload
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=autohttps
Group=autohttps
ExecStartPre=+/usr/local/sbin/autohttps-renew
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/autohttps-server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

[Unit]

[Install]

EOF
